name: trade-surveillance
description: Wash-trade review of one matched order-flow window: decides whether the window shows self-dealing, late reporting, or excessive cancellation.
goal: Decide whether the matched order flow in the review window shows wash trading.

checks.name: self_cross
checks.description: a buy and a sell in the window resolve to the same beneficial account

checks.name: late_reporting
checks.description: the review window closed before every matched trade was reported

checks.name: cancel_ratio_excessive
checks.description: cancellations exceed the venue threshold for the session
